title: LinkedIn voicebook brief JSON
description: Input contract for linkedin_render.py and for the --slots-file coverage checks in linkedin_voicebook_check.py. The render script implements these constraints with stdlib checks (no jsonschema dependency); this file is the machine-readable statement of the same contract.

title.description: article title (DB row; used by the caller, not by the render)

primary_keyword.description: SEO keyword; must appear verbatim in at least one rendered slot; passed to the checker as --keyword

tags.description: topic keywords; passed to the checker as --topics

link.description: public article URL, final line of the rendered post. The anyOf pattern reflects the factory allowlist (example.org); with a live config file the render and checker validate the URL against url_allowlist (regex list) instead, and app.notion.com stays rejected regardless of config.

stat.description: the number the post opens on, as a single sentence fragment with no terminal punctuation

source.description: the survey, study, standard or person, as a phrase; slots into 'SOURCE found STAT.'

topic_claim.description: the settled consensus restated as fact, one sentence

story_examples.description: concrete one-sentence tool/agent examples from the article, no internal sentence break, no trailing punctuation

thesis.description: the article's core architecture answer, 1-3 sentences

design_moves.description: imperative practices; rendered as one comma-joined clause list

counter.description: what the consensus misses, 1-2 sentences (required by V2)

definition.description: coined term plus definition, one sentence shaped 'Term is plain-words definition'

gap_stat_b.description: second contrasting percentage; render joins as '<a>, while <b>'

question_tail.description: exactly one question mark, must address the reader's experience (you/your); rendered as the close

person_context.description: the author's standing clause (duration, role, artifact); no terminal punctuation

consensus_holder.description: named holder of the steelman consensus (V3)

failure_row.description: V4 receipt row: {system, date, what_broke, what_now_catches}; V4 render is refused by design until a real row exists
